text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, where both Duramente and 
Cheval Grand saw victory slip through 
their fingers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Cheval Grand found herself 
completely overwhelmed by Duramente's 
dominant aura during the race, and by her 
unflinching rivals who never lost their 
fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to one day see her puff out her 
chest and say, "I was amazing too!", I 
left the racecourse behind.
